quarterly_data.signal: First half ended September 30, 2025 (semi-annual report): net sales JPY 204,016 million (-2.5%), operating profit JPY 11,790 million (+70.1%), ordinary profit JPY 10.1 billion (+216.3%), profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 5,732 million (JPY 114 million a year earlier). R&D expenses JPY 6.8 billion.
